text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of on-street paid parking on North York Boulevard. The purpose of this request is to add new on-street paid parking to help support local parking demands and encourage parking turnover. Transportation Services and the Toronto Parking Authority staff have identified five pay-and-display parking spots on the south side of North York Boulevard, just west of Yonge Street to allow parking to maximize parking available to patrons.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the amendments to parking regulations required to establish new on-street paid parking locations, as set out in Attachments 2 and 3 "Pay-and-Display Parking - North York Boulevard" to the report (April 28, 2023), from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
